integrity: A complete group-theoretic proof and standalone reproducible finite checker are included. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Covers composition-idempotent group endomorphisms of Dic_m for m>=2, not all endomorphisms. Existing descending-endomorphism classification supplies prior generator-image forms. Historical publication priority is provisional; some related full texts were unavailable. Exhaustive computational tests cover only finite sample parameters.
title: All-arity compatible retractions of dicyclic groups: an odd-prime label law and a diameter-three transition
